subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The patch appears correct for the reported log-flood bug, but it changes when a secrets/auth-sensitive local exec resolution path is chosen before the gateway snapshot path.

options.title: Accept the guarded local skip
options.body: Land this PR after base refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as the intended command-secret behavior.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject or close this PR and tolerate the current recoverable `UNAVAILABLE` noise until maintainers choose a different gateway contract.

options.title: Require a runtime-side redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a broader gateway/runtime-command-secret change if maintainers want partial snapshot success instead of a CLI preflight skip.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded local skip
recommendation.body: Land this PR after base refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as the intended command-secret behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to `steipete`, and the remaining choice is acceptance of an auth/security-boundary behavior rather than a narrow mechanical repair.
